description.value: Sumas Mountain Abbotsford liquor store is a retail alcohol shop located in unit 140 of a commercial building near Sumas Mountain in Abbotsford, BC. Formerly known as Sumas Mountain Wines, it now operates as a general liquor store serving the local community. It may be a convenient stop for cyclists riding routes in the Sumas Mountain area looking to pick up beverages.
